title: orchis fistulosa
intro: Orchis fistulosa, commonly known as the Autumn lady's tresses, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat kidney and bladder issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Orchis fistulosa include its diuretic and expectorant properties, which help to remove excess fluids and promote the clearance of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential antioxidant and antimicrobial effects.
